correctness.rationale: The hat Gram matrix is strictly diagonally dominant. The sign-gauged inverse satisfies an explicit positive second-order recurrence; integration of the alternating kernel and geometric summation yield the closed formula. The required rational identity was checked via symbolic polynomial reduction, and 49 finite-circle examples independently inverted exact Gram matrices. Periodization plus incompatible zero crossing positions proves finite strictness, not merely a numerical inequality.

value.rationale: The exact sharp rational amplification profile identifies how realistic mesh alternation changes the stability of a canonical spline least-squares projector; it sharpens the general 1D constant 3 to exactly 2 on a natural family, proves unique worst mesh balance, and classifies finite cyclic exhaustion with strict finite defect.
